shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every day.
Cooking is one of my favorite hobbies.
I like to take long walks in the park.
Traveling gives me a chance to explore new cultures.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I usually watch movies on weekends with friends.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
I often volunteer at local shelters in my community.
Growing plants at home has become a rewarding activity for me.
Studying a foreign language opens up many opportunities for communication.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you’ve had?
Q2: What challenges did you face during that trip?
Q3: How do you feel about the impact of travel on personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning to travel abroad for the first time?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about sports habits.
questions: Q1: What sports do you enjoy playing or watching?
Q2: Have you ever faced any obstacles in maintaining your fitness routine?
Q3: What is your opinion on the importance of physical activity in daily life?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone trying to get into sports?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your typical daily diet?
Q2: What difficulties do you encounter when trying to eat healthy?
Q3: How do you think diet affects overall well-being?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone wanting to improve their eating habits?
